WHAT I CLOSED THAT THE RESEARCHER LOGGED AS A GAP. The researcher's gap (e) said 'no NLB Group Investor Day 07/05/2026 deck was found on the public IR pages'. The decks ARE public and I downloaded four of them (CEO, CFO, RETAIL, PAYMENTS, all HTTP 200) from https://www.nlbgroup.com/content/dam/nlb/nlb-group/documents/investor-relations/dan-vlagateljev-2026/ - linked from https://www.nlbgroup.com/int-en/investor-relations/investor-day-2026. The likely cause of the miss is a URL-path trap: the Group IR site serves everything under /int-en/, and the bare paths /investor-relations/financial-calendar, /investors and /investors/financial-calendar all return HTTP 404 - which also explains why the 06/08/2026 calendar date and its 23/07-06/08 silent period were not captured first time.

WHAT THE RESEARCH PASS MISSED ENTIRELY. The NLB / Addiko Bank takeover contest, which resolved against NLB two days before this run (acceptance period closed 29/07/2026; RBI announced 56.16% the same evening). This is a footprint-level event for Serbia and is now signal 16. It needs cross-agent confirmation against the Raiffeisen Serbia unit, since the Serbian estate consolidation has moved to Raiffeisen banka Srbija + Addiko Bank Srbija.

(a) The ATM OEM is still not named - my own independent regex scan of the full AR2025 text for twenty vendor names returned zero hits, confirming the researcher's negative finding, and the 2022 Telegraf announcement names no supplier; the operator field-photo task remains the fastest route. (b) The winner and term of the 2025 Group ATM/CDS tenders is not disclosed in any public NLB document I could reach - this is the single highest-value open question and it is answerable only in Ljubljana. (c) The 129-vs-139 branch discrepancy is unresolved; the Group CFO deck's 'rationalization of physical footprint' language makes a genuine net reduction the more likely reading but does not prove it.
